role: A one-shot post-v198 development veto on the historically exposed p=14kw_size=01 trajectory. It tests one fixed identity-prior full-DCT initializer followed by unchanged CGLS K1. It is not fresh validation, external generalization, test evidence, a resource result, or real BOST.
scientific_question: After v198 showed that identity-GCV selects tau=2^-8 on every opened p22 cell, does that single fixed identity-prior regularizer preserve every absolute field, gradient, and observation gate on all 101 frames, 13 calibrations, and both five- and nine-camera arms of p14, while retaining a 2A+1A^T logical online ledger and resisting cheaper-control attribution?

data_isolation.trajectory_role: historically exposed development-validation veto; never fresh, blind, confirmatory, external, or test evidence
data_isolation.frame_indices: all integers 0 through 100 in immutable order
data_isolation.calibration_indices: all integers 0 through 12 in immutable order
data_isolation.observation_build: a separate process may read p14 truth only to apply each frozen forward operator and seal 26 observation arrays; it may not generate a candidate, metric, pass mask, or decision
prediction_forbidden_inputs: p14 truth field before the prediction barrier
PoolFire test data or real BOST
data_isolation.prediction_barrier: all fixed and control coordinates, the bound affine center/basis needed for their deterministic physical lift, residual preparation arrays, factor diagnostics, hashes, and a read-set attestation are sealed before the scorer may open p14 truth; the scorer may reconstruct initializer fields only from that sealed state

primary.name: fixed_identity_tau2m8_full_dct_k1
primary.centered_feature: the exact camera-resolved full 24x24 DCT potential feature after removing one DC coefficient per active camera and subtracting the frozen affine-center response
primary.response: H has one row per 1009 affine coordinates and 575 canonical feature columns per active camera
primary.lambda_rule: lambda=(tau*s_max(H))^2 for the current reported geometry and active-camera set
primary.selection_or_search: none; tau is fixed for every cell, sensor arm, calibration, and frame
primary.formal_factorization: thin float64 scipy.linalg.svd with LAPACK gesdd
primary.independent_factorization: separately coded thin float64 scipy.linalg.svd with LAPACK gesvd plus fixed-candidate normal-equation residual checks
primary.retained_rank: retain singular values at least s_max*sqrt(float64 epsilon); require all 1009 affine directions
primary.final_coordinate: solve the fixed identity Tikhonov system and form x0=affine_center+a affine_basis
primary.refinement: exactly one iteration of the unchanged strict v10.1 identity-preconditioned physical CGLS recurrence

blocking_and_reporting_controls.fixed_identity_initializer_only: the exact same fixed coordinate and field returned without physical CGLS; if it passes at its lower logical exact-call ledger it blocks K1 attribution
blocking_and_reporting_controls.full_dct_k1_parent: tau=0 full-DCT coordinate followed by unchanged physical K1 at the same 2A+1A^T ledger
blocking_and_reporting_controls.full_dct_k2_reference: tau=0 full-DCT coordinate followed by unchanged physical K2 at 3A+2A^T; it must pass before exact-call reduction is interpretable
blocking_and_reporting_controls.affine_jacobi_pcgls1: the v182 affine Jacobi one-step control rebuilt from current observation and geometry
blocking_and_reporting_controls.dual_ridge_rank16_k1: the frozen v180 shared dual-ridge control followed by unchanged physical K1
blocking_and_reporting_controls.control_precedence: any control with forward and adjoint calls both no greater than the primary that passes every strict cell and complete group blocks a fixed-regularizer headroom claim

exact_call_and_cache_ledger.candidate_difference_from_reference: one fewer exact forward and one fewer exact adjoint per cell
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.observation_generation: 26*101 exact forwards are offline simulated-data construction and are never deployment or candidate calls
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.geometry_cache: dense full-DCT responses, affine basis responses, center responses, SVD factors, and control factors are offline costs retained for future whole-pipeline accounting
exact_call_and_cache_ledger.resource_claim: none before a separately frozen fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

required_validity_gates: all parent hashes, statuses, p14 pair roles, affine arrays, calibrations, subsets, frame order, and inputs are unchanged
the observation process writes exactly 26 finite arrays and no prediction, metric, pass mask, or decision

prediction helpers have no truth, metric, frame-index, time, trajectory-label, reference-output, test, or real-data parameter; the formal entrypoint seals all coordinates and deterministic lift bindings before its later scoring phase opens truth

formal and independent implementations each rebuild full-DCT responses, fixed and unregularized coordinates, initializer-only output, PCGLS, dual-ridge, physical K1/K2 controls, metrics, tails, strict masks, and call ledgers
all 1009 response directions are retained and every coordinate, field, residual, metric, stationarity value, and receipt is finite

camera and ray permutations preserve fixed coordinates and fields within 1e-9 relative error; because stationarity is a near-zero diagnostic, its permutation check uses 1e-10 absolute error rather than an unstable relative denominator

formal gesdd and independent gesvd fixed and tau=0 coordinates agree within 1e-8 relative error, and the independent fixed candidate also agrees with a positive-definite normal-equation solve within 1e-8
formal-independent regular arrays agree within 1e-8 relative error and near-zero diagnostics within 1e-10 absolute error
the v198, v197, affine, calibration, subset, and p14 input trees remain unchanged before and after execution
fixed_decision_order: Any binding, isolation, observation, prediction-barrier, rank, finite, stationarity, permutation, physical-replay, control, call-ledger, group-tail, seal, or independent-comparison failure makes v199 inconclusive.
If the full-DCT K2 reference fails any strict cell or complete group, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_P14_REFERENCE_INADEQUATE_V199; do not reinterpret primary numbers as exact-call headroom.

If the fixed identity-prior K1 primary fails any strict cell or complete group, conclude FAIL_FIXED_IDENTITY_PRIOR_P14_V199 and close this exact tau, normalization, full-DCT representation, and K1 shell without tuning.

If the primary passes but initializer-only, unregularized full-DCT K1, Zero, BP-CGLS1, or affine Jacobi-PCGLS1 also passes every strict cell and group at equal-or-lower exact calls, conclude PASS_CHEAPER_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_FIXED_IDENTITY_PRIOR_P14_V199.

Only if the reference and primary pass all cells and groups, every equal-or-lower exact-call control fails, and independent validation passes may v199 conclude PASS_FIXED_IDENTITY_PRIOR_P14_DEVELOPMENT_VETO_V199.

A positive v199 result is only historically exposed p14 development compatibility. It does not authorize claims of fresh validation, external generalization, resource speedup, curved-ray validity, real BOST, paper success, first/SOTA/global uniqueness, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: A valid failure closes fixed identity tau=2^-8 full-DCT K1. Do not tune tau, normalization, DCT roster, K1 depth, thresholds, or controls after p14; do not rescue it with CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, extra exact calls, or GPU training.
prior_art_boundary: Tikhonov regularization, fixed ridge priors, full spectral coordinates, variable-sensor processing, warm starts, and Krylov refinement are established components. No component-level first, SOTA, or global-uniqueness claim is permitted.
